title: New jobs compute defaults to Auto access mode
body:
When you create new jobs compute in the UI, the access mode now defaults to **Auto** instead of **Dedicated**. Auto uses **Standard** access mode unless a machine learning runtime, a GPU instance type, or a Databricks Runtime version lower than 14.3 is selected. A cluster policy that enforces a different access mode still takes precedence. Existing jobs are not changed.

For workspaces with the [compliance security profile](/aws/en/security/privacy/security-profile) enabled, this change takes effect in December 2026. See [What's coming](/aws/en/release-notes/whats-coming#jobs-compute-auto-access-mode-csp).

See [Use standard access mode](/aws/en/jobs/run-classic-jobs#use-standard-access-mode).
